records.deadline_display: Application deadlines vary by country. The nominating U.S. Embassy or Binational Fulbright Commission will advise you of its internal deadline for receiving applications. source.publisher: The Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program (funded by the U.S. Department of State, administered by IIE)
source.raw_extract:
What is the application deadline?

Application deadlines vary by country. The nominating U.S. Embassy or Binational Fulbright Commission will advise you of its internal deadline for receiving applications. U.S. Embassies and Commissions must submit their nominations to the Institute of International Education in Washington, D.C., by mid September.
source.exact_deadline_wording: U.S. Embassies and Commissions must submit their nominations to the Institute of International Education in Washington, D.C., by mid September.
source.notes: The programme publishes NO fixed applicant-facing deadline. The only month-level timing it states is 'mid September', and that is the embassies'/commissions' deadline for submitting nominations to IIE, not the applicant's own deadline, which the programme says 'vary by country' and which each embassy sets internally. Recorded as MONTH because the source gives a month-level point in the cycle with no day, therefore deadline_date stays null and no day was invented. Confidence is MEDIUM, not HIGH, because the month belongs to the nomination step rather than to the applicant step; the companion page https://www.humphreyfellowship.org/how-to-apply/u-s-embassies-commissions/ confirms this reading: "Please contact your country's Binational Fulbright Commission or the U.S. embassy for information on how to apply, including deadlines." No cycle year is stated anywhere on the site, so as_of is null. The programme homepage and /how-to-apply/ carry no deadline at all.

The page repeats the same deferral higher up: "You can find the specific closing dates and the fields of study for this academic year on the website of the institution you want to apply to." The provider's deferral wording is captured verbatim in deadline_display. I did not substitute any participating institution's own deadline: the brief forbids another institution's deadline and any assumption about how the cycle usually runs. Note this record's shard deadline_precision is 'varies', which is not in the brief's enum; the value written here is the brief's UNKNOWN/unknown.

source.raw_extract:
Application Schedule

* International students can matriculate either in March or in September.

Admission Round | 1st Round | 2nd Round (TBD)
Entry Term | Spring 2027 | Fall 2027
Online Application | 10AM on Aug. 26, 2026 -
5PM on Sept. 22, 2026 | March, 2027
Online Application Deadline | 5PM on Sept. 22, 2026 | March, 2027
Document Submission Deadline* | 5PM on Oct. 2, 2026 | March, 2027
Interview (Online) | Dec. 11-12, 2026 | June, 2027
Admission Notification | Dec. 18, 2026 | June, 2027
source.notes: This scholarship has no separate application. UIC's own scholarship page states: "International students applying for UIC will be automatically considered as scholarship candidates. Scholarship recipients are to be selected from admitted applicants according to their academic credentials. A scholarship offer letter will be enclosed in the admission packet and sent to the recipients individually." Because candidacy is conferred at admission, the UIC admission application deadline is this scholarship's operative deadline - it is the same college's own process, not another programme's deadline. Retrieval date is 2026-10-05, by which point the 1st Round had already closed: online application deadline "5PM on Sept. 22, 2026" and document submission deadline "5PM on Oct. 2, 2026" are both in the past, so they are NOT written as the deadline for an open/upcoming record. The next round, 2nd Round for Fall 2027 entry, publishes only "March, 2027" with the column header literally marked "2nd Round (TBD)" - a month with no day, so deadline_date stays null and no day was invented. Confidence MEDIUM rather than HIGH because UIC itself marks the value TBD and may still revise it. No UIC page publishes a separate scholarship application window.

I specifically did not adopt the shard's prior cached 'recurring' precision, because no live official page describes recurring annual application timing for this award.

source.exact_deadline_wording: Application closing date (2026/27): 1 February 2026 (North America undergraduate); 28 February 2026 (Middle East, Africa and Pakistan undergraduate and graduate taught; South Asia graduate taught); 31 March 2026 (all other applicants)
source.notes: expired_mismatch. The only calendar deadlines UCD publishes are the three 2026/27 regional closing dates quoted above: 1 February 2026, 28 February 2026 and 31 March 2026. All three are in the past relative to the 2026-10-05 retrieval date, and the page states in bold that "Applications for the 2026/27 Global Excellence Scholarships are CLOSED!". The record is open/upcoming, so per brief section 6 I am not writing the stale dates and I am NOT rolling them forward to a 2027/28 cycle. The 2027/28 call has not been published: the page's only forward-looking reference is the stale-labelled line "Application Deadlines for 2026/27 TBC:" followed by the same three 2026 dates, which is an internal inconsistency on UCD's part but does not create a new cycle. deadline_semantics is therefore UNKNOWN rather than EXACT - the source is calendar-explicit but every calendar value it gives is expired, and writing EXACT would invite a downstream consumer to store a 2026 date as if current. The exact stale wording is preserved in exact_deadline_wording. I also checked the parent index https://www.ucd.ie/global/study-at-ucd/scholarshipsfinances/scholarships/, which still describes Global Excellence as open but publishes no new dates.

source.raw_extract:
Looking for a scholarship? The scholarships highlighted below are administered by Nuffic. These are not all scholarships out there, so also make sure to contact the institution of your choice to inquire about the possibilities.

In 2024, the Orange Knowledge Programme ended. That means that there are no new application rounds for this programme. For alternative scholarships, please visit the StudyFinder.
source.notes: MATERIAL FINDING FOR THE RECORD, NOT A MISSED DEADLINE: the record is titled 'Orange Knowledge Programme (OKP) 2026', but the provider states the programme has ended and has no application rounds at all. So there is no deadline to recover, in any semantics class - this is not a stale date that could be recovered or rolled forward, it is the absence of a programme. Corroborated on the provider's parent domain: https://www.nuffic.nl/en/international/international-programmes lists the Orange Knowledge Programme under the heading "Programmes previously managed by Nuffic:" and its featured tile reads "Orange Knowledge Programme 2017-2024". The record's own official_source_url (https://www.studyinnl.org/finances) was fetched and does not mention OKP at all. Its shard verification_status is already 'quarantined', which is consistent with this. Recommend the record be treated as a discontinued programme rather than open/upcoming; I have not set outcome expired_mismatch because no deadline was ever published for it, so there is no past date to be stale.
